description: Looks up DataForSEO search volume for keywords you already have, by naming each one to the vendor. Use this to RANK a list -- 'which of these 40 terms is biggest' -- which niche_report cannot answer, because it reads each competitor's top 50 keywords only and everything below that comes back unpriced. This asks across each app's full ranked list instead. Paid: keywords are sent in batches of 150, and each batch is $0.012 per app, plus $0.00012 per keyword actually found -- so 200 keywords across 2 apps is 4 batches, about $0.05. Free for the rest of the UTC day once bought. US storefront only, like all volume in this server. A keyword still comes back unavailable if none of the queried apps ranks for it -- volume exists only as 'the keywords this app ranks for', so the answer depends on which competitors are reached, and it is NEVER evidence a keyword is unpopular.

apps.description: Competitor app ids to price through. STRONGLY PREFERRED: supplying these makes the call cost ZERO App Store requests. Leave empty and the tool searches the App Store for a few of your keywords to find competitors, which is rate-limited.

country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront country code. Volume is "us"-only; any other storefront returns unavailable at no cost.

keywords.description: The keywords to price. Duplicates and casing are normalised.

max_apps.description: How many competitor apps to query. Cost is per app AND per 150-keyword batch: $0.012 x ceil(keywords/150) x apps, so 100 keywords at 2 apps is $0.024 before per-keyword charges. Each app reaches a different ranked-keyword list, so more apps means more keywords priced.

name: price_keywords
title: Search volume for a keyword list
